name: Thrasher Springs Spa + Wellness Resort
source:
Thrasher Springs is a small desert town renowned for its beautiful hot springs. In this visual novel, you play as Den, the masseuse of the local spa who is well known for the special treatment he gives his male clients. Help Den learn about his clients needs, massage them, and give them a happy ending.

Thrasher Springs Spa + Wellness Resort is a sensual game with a focus on narrative and the aesthetic of a desert spa.

[From [url=https://wannabeyourdog2.itch.io/thrasher-springs-spa-wellness-resort]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Thrasher Springs是一个沙漠小镇，以其美丽的温泉而闻名。在这部视觉小说中，你扮演Den，当地一家水疗中心的女按摩师，因为男性顾客提供特殊护理而闻名。帮助Den了解客户的需求，为他们按摩，并给他们一个美好的结局。

Thrasher Springs Spa + Wellness Resort是一款注重叙事和沙漠水疗美学的感性游戏。
